messages:
Marta (PM): Quick sync on Playground streaming UX. Two hotspots: 1) 'Stop' verb vs 'Interrupt' vs 'Pause' and the keyboard affordance. 2) Token indicator: live burn vs end-of-response summary.
Ken (Research): In labs, users often said 'interrupt' felt more cooperative than 'stop' (less destructive). But 'interrupt' is longer and may not fit compact UI.
Sam (Design): Proposal A: keep 'Stop' (familiar), but show secondary microcopy on hover 'Interrupt generation'. Proposal B: use 'Interrupt' in full mode and 'Stop' in compact. Thoughts?
Priya (Frontend): Dev constraints: compact mode swaps to icon-only. We can change aria-labels easily. Concern: changing visible word across breakpoints can confuse muscle memory.
Diego (Eng): Backend emits stream-close events on abort. No difference in behavior if you call it 'stop' or 'interrupt'. Only thing: we should lock keybinding to one verb.
Marta (PM): Keybinding idea: ESC to stop/interrupt. That aligns with expectations. Any accessibility concerns?
Jules (A11y): ESC is fine but must be documented; ensure Escape only acts when the playground composer has focus. Also provide an explicit clickable control. For screen readers, announce: 'Generation interrupted by user' vs 'Generation finished'.
Sam (Design): Token indicator options: a) live token burn near the control (pulse), b) small summary badge on message after finish, c) combined: live tiny meter + final total. I prefer c).
Priya (Frontend): Implementation note: live updates at 600ms; animate the delta. For the meter we can use a neutral tint and fill bar to indicate burn. On low-contrast backgrounds we need a stroke to remain visible.
Jules (A11y): Motion reduce: when prefers-reduced-motion is set, don't animate the meter; update instantly. Color contrast: use >=4.5:1 for numeric badge text.
Ken (Research): Observations: participants liked seeing tokens while streaming for budget awareness, but most didn't want it to steal attention. So subtlety is key.
Sam (Design): For compact/mobile: show just a numeric mini-pill attached to the message timestamp. For desktop: show tiny horizontal sparkline inside the pill to indicate progress.
Priya (Frontend): Sketch for keybindings and controls:
```
// when composer is focused
keydown(esc, () => abortStream())
keydown(r, () => { if (!streaming) regenerate() }) // r for regen shortcut
```
We should avoid conflicting with browser shortcuts.
Diego (Eng): Edge case: user hits ESC multiple times while regen is queued. Debounce on client, and server should return 409 if regen overlaps. Surface a toast: 'Regeneration queued or in progress'.
Marta (PM): Copy choices for toasts: 'Generation interrupted', 'Regenerating...', 'Cannot regenerate yet 10 please wait' (we'll avoid emoji in production copy).
Sam (Design): Accessibility nit: tooltip-based labels aren't reliable for keyboard users. Ensure visible text or aria-label exists. For compact we show icon + aria-label.
Jules (A11y): Also ensure the token count is announced with appropriate context: 'Token usage: 123 tokens used so far'. Role=status and aria-live=polite is recommended.
Priya (Frontend): Prompt library integration: if the user picks a prompt and then hits interrupt, should we pin prompt selection? I think yes — regenerate should reapply the chosen prompt by default.
Diego (Eng): We'll add a promptId field to the regen API so it uses the pinned prompt. Also include a param regen_source: 'manual'|'prompt_lib' to help analytics.
Marta (PM): Decisions?
- Use 'Interrupt' in full UI, show 'Stop' in compact/icon-only to save space.
- ESC will be shortcut to interrupt when composer focused. 'R' for regenerate when not streaming.
- Token indicator: combined live mini-meter + final badge. Throttle updates to 600ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion. Role=status for SRs.
- Regenerate should pin prompt library selection; server will return 409/429 if overlapping, client shows toast.
Agree if no objections.
Sam (Design): +1. I'll mock both full and compact treatments and post a link.
Priya (Frontend): +1. I'll prototype the ESC behavior and aria-live announcements.
Jules (A11y): +1. I'll validate SR reads and contrast.
Diego (Eng): +1. I'll add regen concurrency rules in the API doc.
CI Bot: Build 5202 started for branch playground/interrupt-keybinding 12 unit tests running.
Marta (PM): Thanks team 13 follow-ups: Sam post mocks, Priya share prototype, Diego update API doc, Jules run a quick SR smoke test. We'll review in next UX sync.
